Let $f: l^{\infty} \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ be a continuous linear functional, where $l^{\infty} := \{x=(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}} \subset \mathbb{R} : ||x||_{l^{\infty}} := \sup_{n \in \mathbb{N}} |x_n| < \infty\}$. Assume that $f(x) \ge 0$ for all $x=(x_n)_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ such that $x_n \ge 0$ for all $n \in \mathbb{N}$. Furthermore, let $f(\overline{x}) = 2021$, where $\overline{x} = (1, 1, \ldots)$. Calculate the norm of $f$ in the topological dual of $l^{\infty}$. \[ ||f|| := \sup_{x \in l^{\infty}, x \ne 0} \frac{|f(x)|}{||x||_{l^{\infty}}} \]
Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}.
